source.heading: Part V: Disposition and Offers > Disposition

rows.name: Hostile
rows.offers: Refuses unless the deal serves its objective; then Unlikely
rows.targeting: Picks you whenever its rule allows a choice

rows.name: Open
rows.targeting: Does not pick you between equal candidates

rows.name: Allied
rows.offers: One step better; accepts without rolling if the deal serves its objective
rows.targeting: Never targets you unless its rule forces it
